notes: UNSATISFIABLE CONTRACT: original company goals are preserved. Segment own-size goals and additive quarterly goals cannot all reconcile to those fixed company goals. See failed assertions; do not ship a reconciled-goal claim.

Q4 SPLIT CONFLICT: one period-wide bookings factor moves 4,452.07 between carried-in and period-created expectations. Original company splits are retained; child split reconciliation fails explicitly in audit-only Q4. FY and Q3 splits reconcile.
Scale factors apply only to modeled future cohorts, not actuals or existing-deal expectations. FY factors are weighted summaries of quarter adjustments; FY slices are sums of quarters.

Segment sizes are arithmetic means in the pooled fit evidence windows. The pooled recency won size is incidence weighted; segment arithmetic means can favor faster wins. Conversion and timing remain pooled.
Size gate: at least 10 observed wins within the model horizon; created size also requires 10 known first-recorded amounts. Otherwise pooled, thin sample.

Win-rate color compares actual mature trailing rate to pooled plan-start rate; forecast is pooled. Actual sample <20 suppresses color. Fewer than 5 period wins flags won, size, cycle and bookings without suppressing color.

Owner forecast allocations are capacity projections, not measured rep performance. Hide owner win-rate, cycle and average-won-ARR scorecard cells; offer actual evidence in drilldowns instead. Their timing/conversion are pooled and their size goal is inherited from the segment.
Later hires have no plan-start allocation and no goal-dependent colors. Owners absent from the cutoff roster for other reasons are separately labeled.
The frozen schedule over-covers targets; creation requirements are solver-derived benchmarks, not a uniquely reconciled operating plan.
Reconstructed ownership, segment and quota have no historical versions. A dated refit does not eliminate attribute hindsight.
EVIDENCE GAP: SAP-00778, SAP-00866, SAP-00871 lack plan-cutoff stage history (opening ARR 1,866,323). They count in opening stock but are omitted from frozen existing-pipeline forecasts.
Company report bookings use monthly rounded cents; unrounded v1 forecasts differ by less than one cent. Committed-report equality uses 0.01 tolerance; v1 figures are retained exactly.
Opening is a stock, never summed over quarters. Later-quarter opening goals and future opening stocks are not modeled. FY opening green is tautological.
The company back-test and interval do not validate segment or owner forecasts; no slice intervals are claimed.
Scratch-only. Workspace breadcrumb cannot be written outside permitted roots; next decision is whether to allow company goal wins, size and created ARR to change so goals can reconcile.

failures.name: missing plan stage/amount open records
failures.cause: SAP-00778, SAP-00866 and SAP-00871 have no stage-history rows. Their known opening ARR totals 1,866,323. Core omits them from frozen existing-pipeline forecasts; opening stock still includes them. No future stage was substituted.
